page.overview:
What is Perrserker?

Perrserker resembles its pre-evolution, but its face has been changed dramatically. Its ears have become horns tipped with silver, similar to common depictions of a Viking's helmet. The gold coin on its head has faded to gray, while its face's fur has turned black, but its body has turned brown. It has 2 small horns on its head and 2 half-closed reddish eyes, with a menacing looking smile. It retains the beard from its pre-evolution. Its arms slightly covered in black armbands. Its claws can extend into daggers.

Shiny Perrserker has the silver colorings changed to a more gold-like consistency. The sclera also changes to white.

Perrserker are rowdy and ruthless creatures who always desire to battle and they seem to relish in taking down defenseless foes in combat. In the heat of battle, Perrserker enter trance-like states where they are numb to pain, mercy, and even the orders of their Trainers. They always look down on their counterpart Persian.

Despite being a species infamous for its valor and battle-hunger, Perrserker are actually very lazy when in their domesticated environment, leaving garbage everywhere for their frustrated Trainers to clean up.
